    Import user stories

    Ask your AI to output the format below, then paste it here. Each becomes a To-Do card.
    Show the format / AI prompt

    Simplest \u2014 one story per line:

    As a student, I want my live rank so I know where I stand
As a teacher, I want to bulk-upload questions | supports CSV + XLSX | Panel team

    Or JSON (more detail):

    [
  {"title": "As a student, I want my live rank", "note": "Show percentile vs all attempts", "owner": "App team"},
  {"title": "As a teacher, I want bulk upload", "note": "CSV + XLSX", "owner": "Panel team"}
]

    Prompt you can give any AI:

    Break this feature into user stories. Output ONLY a JSON array where each item has "title" (As a\u2026 I want\u2026 so that\u2026), "note" (acceptance criteria), and "owner" (which team). No prose.
